messages:
elsa: Quick heads-up 1ACME Retail1 asked for per-tenant 'routing parity' for pilot. They want: model allowlist, per-route weight, fallback chain, and audit visibility.
jamal: do they want a policy DSL or just controls surfaced?
paloma: SE summary: no DSL, just controls + deterministic logs for audits. Timeline = pilot next month.
elsa: infra quick take?
ryan: engineering: scoped shim (weights + allowlist + fallback) doable in ~3w with FF and canary. Full policy engine is ~10w. Shim risks: more branching in router but acceptable for pilot.
paloma: commercial: ACME will sign pilot if parity shipped quickly. Competitor promise is tight.
jamal: propose: ship shim for pilot (3w), include per-tenant FF, audit logs, and a written commitment to scope policy engine next quarter. Acceptance: p50 latency +15ms, audit visibility endpoint, per-tenant rollback.
ryan: config example for shim: ```json
{
  "tenant":"acme-retail",
  "routes":[{"name":"default","weight":80,"fallback":["rw-small","rw-mini"],"allowlist":["rw-small","rw-large"]}]
}
```
sales-bot: Created milestone: "acme-parity-shim" target date in 3 weeks.
elsa: action items: @ryan spike perf tests, @paloma draft customer milestone email, @jamal UX mock for admin toggles. Keep thread as source of truth.
jamal: mockups by Wed.
ryan: perf spike running; will post numbers in-thread.
paloma: I'll draft milestone with non-binding commitment language to avoid legal review.
elsa: decision: APPROVE shim path + commit to policy-engine scoping next quarter.
